title: Two- and three-stage triple-pass O-band PDFA designs of Cihangir and Yucel (2025), ref. [89] of rev2.2 ([130] in rev3_assembled.md): simulation study, abstract-level card
model: none in this review. The source reports simulation and parameter optimization of two PDFA configurations; the simulator is not named in the accessible material

device.type: Pr-doped fiber amplifier, simulated, two configurations
device.host: not stated in the accessible material
device.transition: O-band signal on 1G4 -> 3H5 (Pr3+); not stated in the abstract

reference_plane: not stated in the accessible material
source_full: H. Cihangir, M. Yucel, Performance evaluation of two-stage and three-stage triple pass PDFAs in O-band, Opt. Fiber Technol. 95, 104388 (2025), doi:10.1016/j.yofte.2025.104388 (online 12 Sep 2025; issue dated Dec 2025; 39 references in Crossref).

access.read: abstract (AVESIS); keywords (AVESIS): Noise figure, Optical gain, Optimization, PDFA, Three-stage triple-pass configuration, Two-stage triple-pass configuration; OpenAlex keywords add 'tunable laser source' and 'parameter optimization'
access.consequence: every entry below comes from the abstract or from the review manuscript; no parameter value of the doped fiber, pump or signal is available. The authors hold the full text and the simulation project

notes: Category conventions as in TDFA-YUCEL2022: 'config' = design choice or operating condition of the study; material data would be 'lit-other', 'spec' or 'assumed', and a simulator default would carry category 'assumed' with 'OptiSystem default, provenance unknown' (or 'simulator default, provenance unknown' if the simulator is not OptiSystem) in its verification note; none is listed because none is stated in the accessible material. Simulation outputs are kept in 'reported_results'. Level V1 = confirmed against the abstract; V0 = transcribed from a secondary statement (the review manuscript) or applicability not confirmed.

configurations.applies_to: amplifier designs compared in the source; layouts (reflectors, circulators, isolators, pump couplers) not stated in the accessible material

verification.note: abstract read 2026-11-18 (Gazi AVESIS). The abstract labels both designs '2P3S-PDFA' in one sentence and '2S3P-PDFA' / '3S3P-PDFA' elsewhere; the labels of the title are used here

components.applies_to: main design components named by the source

signal_band.applies_to: signal band; signal wavelength(s) and power are optimization variables whose values are not in the abstract

optimized_parameters.applies_to: names of the parameters the source treats as critical and optimizes; none of their values is stated in the accessible material

simulator.value: commercial simulator, described by the review authors as the kind of tool of Table 6 (OptiSystem); name and version not stated in the accessible material of [89]

source.locator: l. 407: the multi-pass TDFA, PDFA and EDFA studies [88-90] 'were carried out with this kind of tool'

verification.note: secondary statement by the review authors; the abstract of [89] says only 'simulation, parameter optimization, and analysis'

reported_results.kind: simulation outputs of the source, not measurements and not card parameters

G_2S3P_opt.applies_to: optimum gain of the two-stage triple-pass design; signal wavelength, input power, pump power and reference plane not stated in the abstract

NF_2S3P_at_opt.applies_to: noise figure at the 2S3P gain optimum ('around 6,5 dB')

G_3S3P_opt.applies_to: optimum gain of the three-stage triple-pass design; conditions as above

NF_3S3P_at_opt.applies_to: noise figure at the 3S3P gain optimum ('around 5,1 dB')

reported_results.differences: 2S3P: 1.7 dB more optimum gain (49.4 - 47.7 dB) and 1.4 dB more NF (6.5 - 5.1 dB) than 3S3P, computed from the abstract values above
reported_results.manuscript_consistency: rev2.2 l. 221 quotes '49.4 dB (6.5 dB NF) and 47.7 dB (5.1 dB NF) for two- and three-stage triple-pass O-band PDFAs'; consistent with the abstract. No operating condition is given there
